page.title: 🔁 Operating Protocol — Notion-First ChatGPT ↔ Claude Relay

text.content: Notion is the persistent system of record. Chat is only the transport channel.

rich_text.plain_text: Notion is the persistent system of record. Chat is only the transport channel.

text.content: The user should only need to send the current work/request to ChatGPT. ChatGPT prepares the next handoff. The user pastes the prepared handoff to Claude. Claude returns its result. The user pastes Claude's result back to ChatGPT. ChatGPT archives the result, audits it, updates the working state, and prepares the next handoff.
